newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 456,100 MT were nine percent below the previous week and the 4-week average.

Major increases for Japan (107,400 MT, reflecting 149,700 MT in new sales and 42,300 cancellations), Taiwan (103,100 MT), Indonesia (60,000 MT), Portugal (45,600 MT, all destination changes), and the Netherlands (43,300 MT, reflecting 4,100 MT in new sales, 40,200 in destination changes and 1,000 cancellations) were partly offset by decreases for unknown destinations (47,200 MT).

Sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year of 22,600 MT were primarily for unknown destinations (20,000 MT). Exports of 520,200 MT were down 36 percent from the previous week and the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (133,600 MT), Mexico (122,000 MT), Israel (50,200 MT), and Portugal (45,600 MT).
